import re
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Login tokens
pw = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
creds={p['account_name']:p['password'] for p in pw}

# simple_note token already can fetch, but reuse
sn_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='jamie-solomon@gmail.com', password=creds['simple_note'])['access_token']

meeting_note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3084, access_token=sn_token)
content = meeting_note['content']
print('Meeting note title:', meeting_note['title'])

# Parse meetings
# Pattern blocks starting with "Meeting Name:"
blocks = re.split(r'\n\s*Meeting Name:\s*', content)
meetings=[]
for b in blocks[1:]:
    # b begins with meeting_name then rest
    lines=b.strip().splitlines()
    if not lines: continue
    meeting_name=lines[0].strip()
    # Extract attendees lines after 'Attendees:' until 'Day:'
    attendees=[]
    attendees_section=False
    day=None
    time_str=None
    for line in lines[1:]:
        s=line.strip()
        if s.startswith('Attendees:'):
            attendees_section=True
            continue
        if attendees_section:
            if s.startswith('Day:'):
                attendees_section=False
            elif s.startswith('-'):
                attendees.append(s.lstrip('-').strip())
                continue
            elif s=='' :
                continue
            else:
                # could be blank or other
                continue
        if s.startswith('Day:'):
            day=s.split(':',1)[1].strip().strip("'")
        if s.startswith('Time:'):
            time_str=s.split(':',1)[1].strip().strip("'")
    meetings.append({'meeting_name':meeting_name,'attendees':attendees,'day':day,'time':time_str})

print('Parsed meetings count:', len(meetings))
for m in meetings:
    print(m)

# Compute this week Monday based on now
now=datetime.now()
weekday=now.weekday() # Mon=0
monday=now - timedelta(days=weekday)
# Normalize to same time? keep date only

day_to_index={'Monday':0,'Tuesday':1,'Wednesday':2,'Thursday':3,'Friday':4,'Saturday':5,'Sunday':6}

for m in meetings:
    idx=day_to_index[m['day']]
    meeting_date=(monday + timedelta(days=idx)).date()
    hh,mm=map(int,m['time'].split(':'))
    meeting_dt=datetime(meeting_date.year, meeting_date.month, meeting_date.day, hh, mm)
    m['meeting_datetime']=meeting_dt
    m['reminder_datetime']=meeting_dt - timedelta(minutes=30)

print('\nNow:', now)
for m in meetings:
    print(m['meeting_name'], 'Meeting:', m['meeting_datetime'], 'Reminder:', m['reminder_datetime'])

# Filter reminder times in future
upcoming=[m for m in meetings if m['reminder_datetime']>now]
print('\nUpcoming reminders:', len(upcoming))
for m in upcoming:
    print(m['meeting_name'], 'at', m['reminder_datetime'])

        if attendees_section:

            elif s.startswith('-'):

                continue

        if s.startswith('Day:'):

meeting_note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3084, access_token=token_sn)
content = meeting_note['content']

blocks = re.split(r'\n\s*Meeting Name:\s*', content)
meetings=[]
for b in blocks[1:]:
    lines=b.strip().splitlines()
    if not lines: 
        continue
    meeting_name=lines[0].strip()

    attendees_section=False
    day=None
    time_str=None
    for line in lines[1:]:
        s=line.strip()
        if s.startswith('Attendees:'):
            attendees_section=True
            continue
        if attendees_section:
            if s.startswith('Day:'):
                attendees_section=False
            elif s.startswith('-'):
                attendees.append(s.lstrip('-').strip())
                continue
            elif s=='':
                continue
            else:
                continue
        if s.startswith('Day:'):
            day=s.split(':',1)[1].strip().strip("'")
        if s.startswith('Time:'):
            time_str=s.split(':',1)[1].strip().strip("'")
    meetings.append({'meeting_name':meeting_name,'attendees':attendees,'day':day,'time':time_str})

print('Parsed meetings:', len(meetings))
for m in meetings:
    print(m)

# --- Compute this-week occurrence reminders (next occurrence of weekday, with reminder in the future) ---
now = datetime.now()
print('Now:', now)

day_to_index={'Monday':0,'Tuesday':1,'Wednesday':2,'Thursday':3,'Friday':4,'Saturday':5,'Sunday':6}

def compute_next_weekday_with_future_reminder(day_name, time_str, now_dt):
    target_idx=day_to_index[day_name]
    hh,mm=map(int,time_str.split(':'))
    # candidate meeting date: next occurrence of weekday
    days_ahead=(target_idx - now_dt.weekday()) % 7
    if days_ahead==0:
        # meeting is today at given time; if already past, push 7 days
        candidate_date=now_dt.date()
    else:
        candidate_date=now_dt.date()+timedelta(days=days_ahead)
    meeting_dt=datetime(candidate_date.year,candidate_date.month,candidate_date.day,hh,mm)
    if meeting_dt <= now_dt:
        meeting_dt += timedelta(days=7)
    reminder_dt=meeting_dt - timedelta(minutes=30)
    while reminder_dt <= now_dt:
        meeting_dt += timedelta(days=7)
        reminder_dt = meeting_dt - timedelta(minutes=30)
    return meeting_dt, reminder_dt

# --- Resolve attendees via phone contacts (canonical) ---
def search_contacts_all(query):
    results=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=token_phone, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        results.extend(page)
        page_index+=1
    return results

my_email='jamie-solomon@gmail.com'

resolved_emails={}  # name -> email
for name in sorted({a for m in meetings for a in m['attendees']}):
    results=search_contacts_all(name)
    exact=[c for c in results if c.get('first_name','').lower()==name.lower()]
    print('\nPhone search for', name, 'total', len(results), 'exact', len(exact))
    for c in exact:
        print(' exact match:', c.get('first_name'), c.get('last_name'), c.get('email'))
    if len(exact)!=1:
        print('AMBIGUITY/NO MATCH for', name)
    else:
        resolved_emails[name]=exact[0]['email']

# --- Build email drafts payload per meeting ---
email_plans=[]
for m in meetings:
    meeting_dt, reminder_dt = compute_next_weekday_with_future_reminder(m['day'], m['time'], now)
    # recipients: all attendees excluding me
    recipient_names = m['attendees']
    recipient_emails=[]
    for nm in recipient_names:
        em = resolved_emails.get(nm)
        if em and em.lower()!=my_email.lower() and em not in recipient_emails:
            recipient_emails.append(em)
    subject=f"Reminder for {m['meeting_name']}"

import re
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# --- Helpers ---

def parse_meetings_from_simple_note(content):
    blocks = re.split(r'\n\s*Meeting Name:\s*', content)
    meetings=[]
    for b in blocks[1:]:
        lines=b.strip().splitlines()
        if not lines:
            continue
        meeting_name=lines[0].strip()
        attendees=[]
        attendees_section=False
        day=None
        time_str=None
        for line in lines[1:]:
            s=line.strip()
            if s.startswith('Attendees:'):
                attendees_section=True
                continue
            if attendees_section:
                if s.startswith('Day:'):
                    attendees_section=False
                elif s.startswith('-'):
                    attendees.append(s.lstrip('-').strip())
                    continue
                else:
                    continue
            if s.startswith('Day:'):
                day=s.split(':',1)[1].strip().strip("'")
            if s.startswith('Time:'):
                time_str=s.split(':',1)[1].strip().strip("'")
        meetings.append({'meeting_name':meeting_name,'attendees':attendees,'day':day,'time':time_str})
    return meetings

# Compute next weekday occurrence, ensuring reminder is in the future

day_to_index={'Monday':0,'Tuesday':1,'Wednesday':2,'Thursday':3,'Friday':4,'Saturday':5,'Sunday':6}

def compute_next_weekday_with_future_reminder(day_name, time_str, now_dt):
    target_idx=day_to_index[day_name]
    hh,mm=map(int,time_str.split(':'))
    days_ahead=(target_idx - now_dt.weekday()) % 7
    candidate_date = now_dt.date() + timedelta(days=days_ahead)
    if candidate_date and (datetime(candidate_date.year,candidate_date.month,candidate_date.day,hh,mm) <= now_dt):
        candidate_date = now_dt.date() + timedelta(days=days_ahead+7)
    meeting_dt = datetime(candidate_date.year,candidate_date.month,candidate_date.day,hh,mm)
    reminder_dt = meeting_dt - timedelta(minutes=30)
    while reminder_dt <= now_dt:
        meeting_dt += timedelta(days=7)
        reminder_dt = meeting_dt - timedelta(minutes=30)
    return meeting_dt, reminder_dt
